page.layout: One centred title block: large capitals THESES, EX VNIVERSA, PHILOSOPHIA, then SELECTÆ, then italic lines and the author's name, with the date and place lines below. Between the lines of print is an engraving of a ship under a cloud with a cherub. No running head, page number or catchword. The handwritten "21" top right and "20." below are not printed and are left out.

l.i: Quas, DEO favente, T. O. M.
Agitabuntur die mensis Augusti, ab hora prima pomeridiana

page.notes: The engraving between the author line and the place line shows a ship under sail with a cherub in the upper left clouds and three stars in the sky. It is not text. The faint text behind the title (D. DOMINO CASPARO VVISSIO, and other lines) is show-through from the reverse side and is left out. The line "Agitabuntur die" and "mensis Augusti..." share one printed line, split here into two lines of the same text. Spacing of the title capitals is as printed.
